authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10066 mārayati gives the mār- kill verb; maral/marla and māryo are ordinary eastern -l and western -y past/infinitive formations. Mār-diyo contains a give light verb and is not assigned as a simple inherited stem. Reviewed comparison: marwari_bagra mārīyɔ “don't kill!, he killed” (f_635k7q3sfgana). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12598 śṛṇoti explicitly gives Bhojpuri sunal and western suṇṇo “hear”. Eastern -l and western -y inflections can continue the hear stem; sun-lo and ambiguous sunā causative/past forms require local morphology. Reviewed comparison: bagri_fatehabad sūṇo “listen!, he heard” (f_2idpviyizywz6). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
